#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long invl(long long a, long long mod) {
    if (a <= 0) return 0;
    return modPow(a % mod, mod - 2, mod);
}

void solve() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long inv = invl(m + 1, MOD);
    long long ans = (1 + inv * n) % MOD;
    long long base = inv * ((long long)m * (m + 2 + (n - 1)) % MOD) % MOD;
    long long u = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        u = (u + invl(i, MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    ans = (base * u + ans) % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
